sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Module overview and imports
sections.what: Nothing runs here. It states the purpose of the file and loads the standard tools.
sections.why: Shows that these are shared helpers rather than calculations for one area.

sections.name: to_decimal
sections.title: Converting any value to exact decimal
sections.what: Turns a number into an exact decimal form, and leaves values that are already decimals unchanged.
sections.why: Likely reason: ordinary decimal numbers can carry tiny errors, while exact decimals keep money figures precise.
sections.watch_out: The conversion goes through text, so a value such as None raises an error.

sections.name: round_decimal
sections.title: Rounding to set decimal places
sections.what: Rounds a decimal to a chosen number of places, rounding halves up.
sections.why: Likely reason: reports need tidy numbers.
sections.watch_out: None of the calculation files shown call this helper, so no rounding is applied in them.

sections.name: safe_divide
sections.title: Dividing without crashing on zero
sections.what: Divides two decimals and returns a default value instead when the divisor is zero.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops a zero denominator from crashing the calculation.
sections.watch_out: The default is returned silently, which can hide missing data.

sections.name: apply_growth
sections.title: Growing one value by one rate
sections.what: Multiplies a value by one plus the growth rate.
sections.why: This is the single step behind every yearly growth calculation.
sections.watch_out: Rates must be decimals; passing 5 instead of 0.05 grows the value by 500 percent.

sections.name: cumulative_growth
sections.title: Series of values from a starting value
sections.what: Starts from a base value and applies each rate in turn, returning the base plus one value per rate.
sections.why: Likely reason: builds the yearly path for prices, costs, and volumes.
sections.watch_out: The returned list is one longer than the rate list, because the base is included, so years must be matched carefully.

sections.name: sum_list
sections.title: Adding a list of decimals
sections.what: Adds all the decimals in a list and returns zero for an empty list.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives a safe way to total yearly lists.
sections.watch_out: An empty list returns zero, which can hide missing data.

sections.name: interpolate
sections.title: Evenly spaced values between two numbers
sections.what: Creates evenly spaced values from a start to an end, including the start but not the end.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: With one or fewer periods it returns only the start value, which may surprise a caller.

summary: Holds small shared helper functions for exact decimal conversion, rounding, safe division, growth, summing, and even spacing between two values.
purpose: Provides the building blocks used across the calculation files.
why: Keeps common logic in one place so every module handles numbers the same way.
how: Each helper does one job: convert a value to an exact decimal, round a value, divide safely, apply one growth step, build a series of growing values, add a list, or space values evenly between two numbers.
inputs: Numbers, exact decimals, lists of growth rates, and period counts.
outputs: Exact decimal values or lists of them. Safe division returns a default value when dividing by zero.
risks: Converting a value goes through its text form, so an empty or non-numeric value raises an error. Only round_decimal does rounding, and it is not called by the calculation files shown. Dividing by zero is only handled in safe_divide.
debug: If a module gives a surprising number, check the helper it uses here first. Test a helper with a known value to confirm it behaves as expected.
